architectural_decisions.rationale: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform. The use of this pattern provides several advantages to the system, such as: Increasing the security of the system by reducing the gateways to the outside, as the only way to interact with the microservices is through the Api Gateway. It gives the ability to handle partial system failures, managing which services are running at all times. It is only the Api Gateway that is responsible for authorization and SSL with the client.
This framework allows the creation of a secure and complex REST API in an easier way than using NodeJS directly.
It has been decided to use this language, and not JavaScript, because it is the default language for NestJS and because thanks to its static typing it allows the detection of errors at compile time.
It has been decided to use AWS and not other cloud services due to its low price and its previous use by the company.
The objective of these services is to form a data lake where all history is stored so that it can be processed in the analytical module.
For the data transmission to be as fast as possible, two Amazon services have been used, which allow us to perform a transmission in near real time.
